title: SINOR MARINE
subtitle: Offshore Vessel Explorer
text: Sinor Marine presents the Offshore Vessel Explorer. An interactive digital model of a DP2 offshore support vessel, running in any web browser.

title: Explore the vessel
subtitle: Orbit, zoom and select any system
text: Every system on board, from the bridge to the seabed, can be explored in three dimensions. Orbit around the ship, zoom in, and labels appear beside each system.

title: Visual modes
subtitle: Realistic · Blueprint · X-ray
text: Switch between realistic, blueprint and X-ray views, to see the structure, the layout, and the equipment hidden inside the hull.

title: Integrated Bridge System
subtitle: Radar, ECDIS and conning on one redundant network
text: On the bridge, the integrated bridge system brings radar, electronic charts and conning together, on a dual redundant network.

title: Bow Tunnel Thruster
subtitle: Controllable pitch with the Z-Thrust panel
text: The controllable pitch bow thruster responds live to every command. Pitch, power and thrust are shown on its control panel, and the exploded view opens up the whole assembly.

title: Dynamic Positioning
subtitle: DP2 station keeping with live redundancy
text: The dynamic positioning system holds the vessel on station. Start DP, hand the thrusters over from the bridge, then fail a controller, and watch the vessel keep its position.

title: Hydroacoustic Position Reference
subtitle: Type 7950 deployment machine · HPT 5000
text: For acoustic positioning, the deployment machine lowers the USBL transceiver through the hull, with full gate valve interlocks, and tracks a transponder on the seabed.

title: RadaScan View and CyScan AS
subtitle: Radar and laser references, installed to the makers' guides
text: The radar and laser references are installed where their makers recommend, on the aft bridge deck, facing the platform. When fog blocks the laser, the radar keeps on tracking.

title: DGPS and Taut Wire
subtitle: Dual Seastar receivers · SMT Taut Wire 2.0
text: Dual D G P S receivers give an absolute position, while the taut wire swings out and lowers its four hundred kilogram weight to the seabed, measuring the angle of the wire.

title: SPRINT-Nav DP
subtitle: Inertial and Doppler reference on the over-the-side pole
text: On its over-the-side pole, SPRINT-Nav adds an inertial and Doppler reference.

title: Every reference, one DP system
subtitle: Weighting and automatic rejection
text: The DP system weighs every reference together, and automatically rejects one that starts to drift.

title: SINOR MARINE
subtitle: Explore every system, anywhere
text: Sinor Marine. Explore every system, anywhere.
